pages.text: "A station!" Pipi called. Four hedgehog musicians picked up their instrument cases. They had arrived. Mom said, "Stand at the door and see them off, Bami. That's a conductor's job."
Bami tucked their face into the teal scarf. "I'm too shy..." They wanted to wave, but the thought of all four watching made their heart thump.
The train stopped, and the band stepped onto the snowy platform. The largest hedgehog waved. "Bye, Conductor Bami!" Bami hid beneath the table. "I don't want to..."
Mom peeked underneath and curled up beside Bami. "There you are. Feeling shy? That's okay. I did, too, at first. Shall we try a little at a time?"
"Not all at once. First, a tiny wave just to me?" Mom whispered. Bami fluttered a wingtip. "Wonderful!" Mom beamed.
"Now at the window, together!" They waved side by side. The hedgehogs saw and waved back. Not as scary as expected! Bami's beak tipped into a smile. "Wave your wings!"
"Now at the door!" Mom nudged Bami's back. Alone at the doorway, Bami opened their wings wide and waved. "Goodbye!" A small voice, but they finished!
Ding! The train moved slowly. On the platform, all four opened their cases. Toot! Boom! "Conductor Bami, you're the best!" A little song followed the train. Bami blushed. "I did it!"
Now Bami knew the steps. "One, say 'I'm shy.' Two, a small wave to Mom first! Three, a big wave at the door!" Near the next station, Bami stood at the door first. "My turn!"
Mom touched her beak to Bami's crown. "Little steps helped, even when you were shy." Wave your wings! Bami's wings fluttered again today.
